note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Swahili, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-sw-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-sw). This is an Ochorus Original, so every quotation was taken from OWB verbatim (founder decision for Originals and for Swahili).

A `mined` row is a quotation whose every piece (pieces joined by an ellipsis allowed) is a verbatim span of the cited OWB verse(s), checked mechanically against the bundle with punctuation and case folded. A `self_rendered` row did not pass that check: the quotation was recast to fit the sentence or the translator rendered it; the reviewer should compare it with OWB.
